summary: Iteration 20 verified end-to-end. Spot values verified: Apple K_meq≈4.0; new entries Muskmelon (fruit YELLOW K=400 Na=24), Karela+Raw Banana (veg YELLOW K=280/400 Na=null), Dhokla (snack YELLOW K=240 Na=310 hs=false), Pani Puri (K=250 Na=450 hs=TRUE), Banana Chips (K=140 Na=null), Almond Milk (bev GREEN K=67 Na=60), Jaljeera (YELLOW K=150 Na=600 hs=TRUE), Aam Panna (YELLOW K=150 Na=800 hs=TRUE), Thandai (RED K=425 Na=109 hs=false), Egg Yolk alone (protein RED K=19 Na=8 hs=false, K_meq=0.5). Regression preserved: /api/foods, /api/foods/food-toor-dal, /api/auth, /api/meal-logs CRUD, nutrient_unit mg↔mEq round-trip. Muskmelon fruit row also verified.
critical_code_review_comments: guide_utils.py enrich_entry() is clean, single source of truth for potassium_meq and high_sodium — no hand-conversion in guide dicts (verified). sodium_mg=null preserved (never guessed).

FoodGuideLayout row testID uses slug(entry.name); note testIDs for entries with long names (e.g. 'Thandai (festival, milk-based)') become long slugs like 'beverage-row-thandai-festival-milk-based-*'. The Jaljeera/Aam Panna/Egg Yolk (alone) entries used shorter names so `beverage-row-jaljeera-high-sodium` etc. match the spec exactly.
guide_needs_sourcing.csv total row count is 156 (7 flagged + 149 sodium-null), well within expected 140–200 band — bookkeeping pipeline mirrors needs_manual_review.csv convention.
seed_data_creation: none — uses seeded demo@renal.app user (nutrient_unit patched to mg and back to mEq during test; final left at mEq per test flow — non-destructive).
context_for_next_testing_agent: For iteration 20 the guide row testID pattern is `{prefix}-row-{slug(name)}[-k|-high-sodium]`. Full names of new entries in the guide dicts are longer than the spec's short-hand (e.g. 'Thandai (festival, milk-based)', 'Unsweetened Almond Milk (plain, store-bought)', 'Dhokla (steamed, plain)', 'Pani Puri / Golgappa', 'Banana Chips (Kerala, coconut-oil fried)', 'Muskmelon (Kharbuja)', 'Egg Yolk (alone)').
